name: slide-to-confirm
title: Slide to confirm
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Slide the handle, or hold Arrow Right, past a threshold before the action runs.

meta.descriptionEs: Desliza el control, o mantén flecha derecha, más allá de un umbral antes de que corra la acción.

examples.title: Deslizar para confirmar
examples.description: Desliza el control, o mantén flecha derecha, más allá de un umbral antes de que corra la acción.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: 320px, texto largo, y lectura de derecha a izquierda.

api.name: onConfirm
api.description: Runs once the threshold is crossed.

api.name: threshold
api.description: Fraction of the track, from 0 to 1. Default 0.9.

api.name: resistance / smoothness / resetAfter
api.description: Drag resistance, spring smoothness, and reset delay in milliseconds.

api.name: label
api.description: Accessible name and visible label. Default Slide to confirm.

docs: Adapted from Evil Buttons slide-to-detonate (Apache-2.0, radiumcoders). Keyboard uses ArrowRight in steps of 0.1. Vibration was removed. Reduced motion snaps the handle. See NOTICE. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
